Others are Given Preference over the Ansaar in the matter of Khilaafah
What Rasulullaah ﷺ said about the Quraysh

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Humayd bin Abdur Rahmaan Himyari
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Humayd bin Abdur Rahmaan Himyari narrates that when Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was at one end of Madinah (where he lived). When he arrived, he opened the face of Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "May my parents be sacrificed for you! You are so pure in life and death. I swear by the Rabb of the Kabah that Muhammad ﷺ has indeed passed away."
(When he heard that the Ansaar had gathered to discuss the Khilaafah,) Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) followed by Hadhrat Umar (RA) went to the Ansaar. In his talk to the Ansaar, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) did not omit to mention any verse of the Qur'aan or statement of Rasulullaah ﷺ concerning the virtues of the Ansaar. He also said, "I am also aware that Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'If everyone walks a valley and the Ansaar walk another valley, I shall walk the valley of the Ansaar.' O Sa'd[^2]! Because you were sitting there, you know that Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'The Quraysh are the successors of this matter (Khilaafah). Righteous people will follow the righteous of the Quraysh while sinful people will follow the sinful of the Quraysh." Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) confirmed this when he said to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA), "You have spoken the truth. We shall be viziers while you are the leaders." [^3]
The Incident that Occurred in the Hall of the Banu Saa'idah Tribe

Hadhrat Abu Sa'eed Khudri (RA) narrates that after Rasulullaah ﷺ passed away, several speakers from the Ansaar delivered lectures (in the orchard of the Banu Saa'idah tribe where the Muhaajireen and the Ansaar had gathered to discuss the Khilaafah). One of them said, "O assembly of Muhaajireen! Whenever Rasulullaah ﷺ appointed one of you to a post, he would also put one of us with him. We therefore feel that two persons should take this post, one from us and one from you." The other speakers from the Ansaar followed suit until Hadhrat Zaid bin Thaabit (RA) stood up and said, "Since Rasulullaah ﷺ was from amongst the Muhaajireen, the leader should be from the Muhaajireen. We shall be his Ansaar (helpers) just as we were the Ansaar (helpers) of Rasulullaah ﷺ."
Ibn Abi Dunya in Ashraaf, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.134).
Hadhrat Sa'd bin Ubaadah (RA), one of the leaders of the Ansaar.
Ahmad and Ibn Jareer, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.3 Pg.137). Haythami (Vol.5 Pg.191) has commented on the chain of narrators.
